newsitem.title: GREECE: LAZARIDIS REPLACES DASKALAKIS AS NEW CEO OF DEP.
newsitem.headline: LAZARIDIS REPLACES DASKALAKIS AS NEW CEO OF DEP.

text.p: The board of directors of Greece's state Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) appointed Lazaros Lazaridis as its new CEO to replace outgoing Manolis Daskalakis.
Daskalakis will be running with the socialist PASOK party in the Athens second district.
"In DEP, I have had the best working relations," said Daskalakis. "Today is like a separation day from a big love affair."
"I will always be close to the petroleum sector and while in parliament," he told colleagues. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
